> day for Binance Agent ID wallets. First Wave daily free, extras 0.0002 BNB,
> cap 5 per wallet. Seal daily 05:00 UTC; claims in $REZ open at the seal and
> never expire. Bands: under 25 unique agents 2,500 $REZ, 25-100 = 12,500,
> over 100 = 60,000, Perfect Resonance 250,000. Unclaimed $REZ burns at pool
> launch. Pre-launch: contracts announced on the site before Wave 1.
